positive_snippets:
The Vibe: A budget-friendly, functional hotel primarily used by solo business travelers, people with work in Noida’s IT sectors, or those needing a quick stopover near the Delhi-Meerut Expressway.
The Good:
Value for Money: Rooms are very affordable, typically ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹2,000.
Accessibility: It is very close to the Noida Electronic City Metro and the expressway.
Service: Many guests praise the owner and staff for being cooperative and polite.
The Bad:
Surroundings: Since it's located at the edge of Khoda, the immediate vicinity can be dusty, crowded, and not very "scenic."

Check-in and Staff: The check-in process was efficient, and staff members exhibited professionalism and courtesy.

Room: The room was spacious and well-equipped with all necessary amenities.  However, the bed exhibited some minor noise due to perceptible creaking sounds from the plywood.

Housekeeping: Housekeeping services were satisfactory.

Amenities:  All required amenities were readily available.

Food and Beverage:  Food and beverage services were not utilized.

Check-out Experience: The check-out process was seamless and efficient.

Overall: The stay was comfortable and provided excellent service, representing exceptional value for the price.

The fundamentals here are spot on. The rooms and bathrooms are clean, spacious and as described in the photos shared by the property. The staff is friendly and very accommodating to guest requests. They took wonderful care of my room and helped me with my food orders and service apart from keeping the room tidy. I will definitely be back to this property for my future business trips. Rooms here are as good as the Double Tree by Hilton that's close by and better than the ibis nearby at a fraction of the cost. There were some minor things that could be improved in terms of expanding the food menu and choices. The property was very receptive to inputs and promised to give us more variety on our next stay.

I have stayed here 3 times thus far and i still believe this is a wonderful place to stay.
